Start and Stop Process

ⓘUsing Vincere Ninja Manager (VNM)? You don’t need this page, because VNM handles startup for you. This page is the manual startup and shutdown process.
Your week at a glance All times are ET
MondayStartupNinjaTrader was shut down Friday, so start it up.See steps → Tue to FriStartup checkNinjaTrader is usually already running. Connect to your VPS, then start at step 3.See steps → WednesdayRestartAfter the trading day, after 4:35p ET.See steps → FridayShut downAfter 4:35p ET. Stays off for the weekend.See steps →
1
Daily Startup Every trading day
By 9:28a ET or earlier
  1. Connect to your VPS by clicking the Remote Desktop shortcut (or the Windows App on Mac / Apple).
  2. Once the VPS loads in another window, double-click NinjaTrader to launch. Already up? NinjaTrader will likely already be up every day except Monday, because of the Friday shutdown. If it’s already open, go straight to step 3.
  3. Go to the Connections menu > Live.
  4. Verify charts are running: the price should be moving on the right side of the chart. Tip: MNQ (Nasdaq) is usually the best one to check, because it moves a lot.
  5. Enable all strategies by 9:28a ET or earlier.
  6. After enabling, check the Strategies tab: all strategy boxes should be green / true.
  7. You’re ready to trade. Leave NinjaTrader running.
2
Wednesday Restart Once a week, after the trading day is over
After 4:35p ET
  1. Wait until the trading day is over (after 4:35p ET).
  2. Save your charts before you restart.
  3. Restart NinjaTrader. Close it with the red X on the Control Panel only (see how to shut down), then open it again.
  4. Reload your saved chart layout with the red icon in NinjaTrader, or the red icon on the desktop.
  5. The next morning, follow Daily Startup.
3
Friday Shutdown Once a week, for the weekend
After 4:35p ET
  1. Wait until the trading day is over (after 4:35p ET).
  2. How to shut down: click the red X on the Control Panel only.
    ⚠️Not the red X in Charts or Backtest. Those will be lost permanently.
  3. Leave it shut down until Sunday night or Monday morning.
Monday: when you bring it back up, follow Daily Startup.
⚠
Key Warnings
  • Never close charts with the red X. They disappear permanently.
  • Never close backtest with the red X. They disappear permanently.
  • Only restart or shut down after the trading day is over (after 4:35p ET).
ⓘThis process keeps your cash account setup stable, your algos running, and your data safe.
